## What's Changed

* Fix macOS global-pointer drags so window moves, text selection, and Finder drag-and-drop receive the motion and gesture events needed to start a real drag session.
* Report the drag delivery path and explain when window-server dragging requires `OPEN_COMPUTER_USE_ALLOW_GLOBAL_POINTER_FALLBACKS=1`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/iFurySt/open-codex-computer-use/compare/v0.3.4...v0.3.5
